title.english: The Other End of the Task

pairs.target: kǎohé nàtiān , tǎ wéi qǐ zǎo le , fàntīng hái méi kāimén .
pairs.english: On assessment day, Tavi got up too early; the dining hall had not opened yet.
pairs.hanzi: 考核那天，塔维起早了，饭厅还没开门。

pairs.target: tā zài táijiē shàng zuò le yíhuìer , mō chū zuówǎn liú de bànkuài bǐng . bǐng yìng le , yǎo xiàqù , xì zhā diào zài yījīn shàng .
pairs.english: He sat on the steps for a while and took out half a flatbread saved from last night. It had hardened; when he bit it, fine crumbs fell on his tunic.
pairs.hanzi: 他在台阶上坐了一会儿，摸出昨晚留的半块饼。饼硬了，咬下去，细渣掉在衣襟上。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng chèn zhèdiǎn shíjiān zài bèi yíbiàn biǎo shàng de cìxù , què fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí zài tīng liànxí lóu nàbiān yǒuméiyǒu rén kāisuǒ .
pairs.english: He had meant to use the time to recite the sequence on the sheet again, but found he kept listening for someone unlocking the practice building.
pairs.hanzi: 他本想趁这点时间再背一遍表上的次序，却发现自己一直在听练习楼那边有没有人开锁。

pairs.target: yīwén guòlái shí , tā yǐjīng bǎ bǐng chī wán . yīwén méiyǒu shuō yídìng néng guò , zhī dìgěi tā yìbēi rèshuǐ , shuō mǐlā jīntiān yào tóng sū yǐ qù gōngfáng kàn cáiliào , lái bùliǎo .
pairs.english: When Iven arrived, he had finished the bread. Iven did not promise he would pass, only handed him hot water and said Mira was going to inspect materials at the works with Suyi today and could not come.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文过来时，他已经把饼吃完。伊文没有说一定能过，只递给他一杯热水，说米拉今天要同苏苡去工房看材料，来不了。

pairs.target: tā tuō tā dài huà , wěnzhù hé sòng xiāo , bié yòu shuō chéng tóngyígè hǎo le .
pairs.english: She had asked him to pass on a message: do not turn ‘stable’ and ‘insert’ back into the same ‘ready.’
pairs.hanzi: 她托他带话，稳住和送销，别又说成同一个好了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , jiēguò shuǐ , mànmàn hē dào bú tàng zuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled, took the water, and sipped slowly until it no longer burned his mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，接过水，慢慢喝到不烫嘴。

pairs.target: jìnwū yǐhòu , tā cái kànjiàn nài lěi zuòzài kàoqiáng de wèizhì . tā miànqián yě yǒu yìzhāng biǎo , méi cháo tā zhāoshǒu , zhī zài tā kàn guòqù shí diǎn le diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Only inside did he notice Nerai seated against the wall with a sheet before her too. She did not wave, only nodded when he looked over.
pairs.hanzi: 进屋以后，他才看见奈蕾坐在靠墙的位置。她面前也有一张表，没朝他招手，只在他看过去时点了点头。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhàn zài zhuō hòu , pángbiān háiyǒu yíwèi fùzé zhuāngpèi de lǎoshī , xiùkǒu fèng zhe yíkuài huībù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey stood behind the table, beside another teacher responsible for assembly, a grey patch sewn to his cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师站在桌后，旁边还有一位负责装配的老师，袖口缝着一块灰布。

pairs.target: sòng xiāo de búshì xuéshēng , shì gōngfáng lái de yígè niánqīng gōngrén . tā bǎ míngzì shuō le yíbiàn , jiào shí yán , tānkāi shǒu gěi tǎ wéi kàn , zhǐ cè yǒu hòujiǎn , yòu mǔzhǐ de zhǐjiǎ quē le yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: The pin-handler was not a student but a young worker from the works. He introduced himself as Shiyan and showed Tavi his open hands, thick calluses on his fingers and a corner missing from his right thumbnail.
pairs.hanzi: 送销的不是学生，是工房来的一个年轻工人。他把名字说了一遍，叫石延，摊开手给塔维看，指侧有厚茧，右拇指的指甲缺了一角。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhào nǐ shuō de dòng . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I will move as you tell me,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我照你说的动。”他说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān méi shēnshǒu . tā kànguò mù zuò , qīngzǎi hé zhǐ dǎng , qǐng wéi lǎoshī héduì jiēchùmiàn yǔ wánzhěng tǐjī , zài dú guò jīxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi did not reach out yet. He checked the wooden bases, light loads and stops, asked Instructor Vey to verify the contact patches and whole volumes, then read the baselines.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先没伸手。他看过木座、轻载和止挡，请维老师核对接触面与完整体积，再读过基线。

pairs.target: jīntiān yòng de réng shì shúxī de pèiduì tiěpiàn , zhǔnbèi hǎo de kè cáo méiyǒu huànchéng biéde dōngxī . liǎngbiān xièzài , fù zǎi yǐhòu , tā bàochū yuánwèi , fùzé zhuāngpèi de lǎoshī zài biǎo shàng jì le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: Today’s pair were still the familiar iron strips with the same prepared grooves. After unloading and reloading both sides, he reported the starting positions, and the assembly teacher made a note.
pairs.hanzi: 今天用的仍是熟悉的配对铁片，准备好的刻槽没有换成别的东西。两边卸载、复载以后，他报出原位，负责装配的老师在表上记了一笔。

pairs.target: shí yán ná qǐ xiāozǐ , wèn zìjǐ gāizhàn nǎlǐ . tǎ wéi chàdiǎn shuō suíbiàn , suíhòu qǐng tā xiān kōngshǒu shì .
pairs.english: Shiyan picked up the pin and asked where he should stand. Tavi almost said anywhere, then asked him to rehearse empty-handed first.
pairs.hanzi: 石延拿起销子，问自己该站哪里。塔维差点说随便，随后请他先空手试。

pairs.target: shí yán cóng yòubiān guòlái , zǒu dào yíbàn , zhǒu shàng yīliào cā guò mù zuò , biàn zìjǐ tíngzhù , bǎ xiùkǒu zhé le liǎngzhé .
pairs.english: Shiyan reached from the right; halfway through, the cloth at his elbow brushed the base, so he stopped himself and folded his cuff twice.
pairs.hanzi: 石延从右边过来，走到一半，肘上衣料擦过木座，便自己停住，把袖口折了两折。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí xíng . " tā shuō . tǎ wéi wèn tā kàn bu kàndéqīng kǒng . tā shuō kàndéqīng , yòu yòng méiyǒu ná xiāozǐ de shǒu shìleshì tuì kāi de dìfāng .
pairs.english: “This works,” he said. Tavi asked whether he could see the hole clearly. He said yes, then checked his withdrawal space with his empty hand.
pairs.hanzi:
“这回行。”他说。
塔维问他看不看得清孔。他说看得清，又用没有拿销子的手试了试退开的地方。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén yuē hǎo , wěnzhù bú dòng , tīngjiàn sòng xiāo zài dòng , shuí shuō tíng dōu tíng .
pairs.english: They agreed to stay still on ‘stable,’ move on ‘insert,’ and stop whenever either said ‘stop.’
pairs.hanzi: 两个人约好，稳住不动，听见送销再动，谁说停都停。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiào tāmen kāishǐ . tǎ wéi jiāng shǒu tái dào zhuōbiān , shí yán hūrán shuō děng yíxià .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey told them to begin. Tavi raised his hands to the table edge, and Shiyan suddenly said to wait.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师叫他们开始。塔维将手抬到桌边，石延忽然说等一下。

pairs.target: tā tíngzhù , méiyǒu luò shǒu . shí yán dītóu jiāng xiāozǐ zài dié lǐ zhuǎn le gè fāngxiàng , yuánlái liúzhì tóu cháolǐ , tā gāngcái ná fǎn le .
pairs.english: He stopped without lowering his hands. Shiyan looked down and turned the pin in the dish: the retaining head faced inward; he had picked it up backward.
pairs.hanzi: 他停住，没有落手。石延低头将销子在碟里转了个方向，原来留置头朝里，他刚才拿反了。

pairs.target: wūlǐ ānjìng dé hěn . tǎ wéi tīngjiàn zìjǐ bízi lǐ nà kǒuqì , jìng bǐ zuòzài ménwài shí wěn .
pairs.english: The room was very quiet. Tavi heard his own breathing, surprisingly steadier than when he sat outside.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里安静得很。塔维听见自己鼻子里那口气，竟比坐在门外时稳。

pairs.target: tā búbì yīnwèi lǎoshī jiào kāishǐ , jiù tì zhuōbiān de rén gǎn nà yíbù .
pairs.english: He did not have to rush the person beside him simply because the teacher had said to begin.
pairs.hanzi: 他不必因为老师叫开始，就替桌边的人赶那一步。

pairs.target: shí yán chóngxīn zhàn hǎo , shuō kěyǐ . tǎ wéi tiē shàng liǎngcè , děng dúshù wěndìng , bào wěnzhù . niánqīng gōngrén de shǒu xuán zài dié biān , yídòngbudòng .
pairs.english: Shiyan settled again and said he was ready. Tavi contacted both sides, waited for stable readings and called ‘stable.’ The young worker’s hand hovered motionless beside the dish.
pairs.hanzi: 石延重新站好，说可以。塔维贴上两侧，等读数稳定，报稳住。年轻工人的手悬在碟边，一动不动。

pairs.target: zhídào tā shuō sòng xiāo , liǎngzhīshǒu tóngshí líkāi jiēchùmiàn , nà zhī dài jiǎn de shǒu cái cóng pángbiān shēn lái .
pairs.english: Only when he said ‘insert’ and lifted both hands from the contact patches together did the callused hand reach in from the side.
pairs.hanzi: 直到他说送销，两只手同时离开接触面，那只带茧的手才从旁边伸来。

pairs.target: xiāozǐ zài dìyīshēng bǎi xiǎng qián luò le jìnqù .
pairs.english: The pin dropped into place before the first pendulum click.
pairs.hanzi: 销子在第一声摆响前落了进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu zhòng chù , qǔxiāo , děngdào zhèngcháng dúshù cái sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi recontacted with both hands and cancelled, releasing only after the readings were normal.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手重触，取消，等到正常读数才松开。

pairs.target: zhuāngpèi lǎoshī méiyǒu lìkè shuōhǎo , ràng shí yán tuìhòu , zài xièzài , fù zǎi , chákàn xiāo tóu . jiājù méiyǒu biànxíng , liǎngpiàn tiě de huí dú yě duì dé shàng .
pairs.english: The assembly teacher did not approve immediately; he had Shiyan step back, unloaded, reloaded and checked the pin head. The fixture was not deformed, and both iron samples’ return readings matched.
pairs.hanzi: 装配老师没有立刻说好，让石延退后，再卸载，复载，查看销头。夹具没有变形，两片铁的回读也对得上。

pairs.target: " ruò méiyǒu zhèdiǎn bǎoliú , nǐ zěnme zhuāng ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “How would you assemble it without this brief residue?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “若没有这点保留，你怎么装？”他问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yìyǎn zhuōbiān bèiyòng de luó jiá , shuō kěyǐ xiān yòng tā yāzhù , zài sòng xiāo , zhǐshì duō yícì nǐngjǐn hé sōngkāi , shǒu yào huàn wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced at the spare screw clamp by the table and said it could hold the part before inserting the pin, with an extra tightening and loosening step and a change of hand position.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一眼桌边备用的螺夹，说可以先用它压住，再送销，只是多一次拧紧和松开，手要换位置。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tā shuō jùtǐ yā nǎlǐ . tā dūnxià , cóng cèmiàn zhǐ gěi tā kàn , méiyǒu zhēnde qù nǐng .
pairs.english: The teacher asked exactly where he would clamp. He crouched to point from the side, without actually tightening anything.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他说具体压哪里。他蹲下，从侧面指给他看，没有真的去拧。

pairs.target: lǎoshī tīng wán , yòu wèn ruò mù zuò sōng le , gāngcái de fāngfǎ néng bunéng zhào zuò . " bùnéng . xiān tíng , xièzài , chóngxīn gùdìng . "
pairs.english: After listening, the teacher asked whether the method would still work if the base came loose. “No. Stop first, unload, and secure it again.”
pairs.hanzi:
老师听完，又问若木座松了，刚才的方法能不能照做。
“不能。先停，卸载，重新固定。”

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā dá dé hěnkuài . shuōwán cái jì qǐ , zìjǐ yǐqián yě céng chàdiǎn bǎ yáohuàng de diànkuài dàngchéng tiěpiàn de biànhuà . nàjiànshì méiyǒu cóng biǎo shàng xiāoshī , rújīn què yě bù zhī shèngxià diūliǎn .
pairs.english: This time he answered quickly. Only afterward did he recall nearly mistaking a wobbling support block for a change in the iron before. That incident had not vanished from his record, but now it held more than shame.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他答得很快。说完才记起，自己以前也曾差点把摇晃的垫块当成铁片的变化。那件事没有从表上消失，如今却也不只剩下丢脸。

pairs.target: kǎo wán , tā de shǒuzhǎng chū le hàn , zhǐtou huán qīngchǔ , yǎnqián yě méiyǒu huā .
pairs.english: Afterward his palms were sweaty, but his fingers still felt clear and his vision had not blurred.
pairs.hanzi: 考完，他的手掌出了汗，指头还清楚，眼前也没有花。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā lí zhuō xiūxi , jiào xià yíwèi jìnlái . tā zǒu dào láng xià , yīwén lìkè zhàn qǐ , tǎ wéi xiān shuō zìjǐ méi nòng huàidōngxī , yīwén shuō zhèhuà tīng zhe bú xiàng jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey sent him away from the table to rest and called the next candidate. In the corridor Iven stood at once; Tavi first said he had not broken anything, and Iven said that did not sound like a result.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他离桌休息，叫下一位进来。他走到廊下，伊文立刻站起，塔维先说自己没弄坏东西，伊文说这话听着不像结果。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , nài lěi ná zhe qiānguò de biǎo chūlái .
pairs.english: After a while, Nerai emerged with the signed sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，奈蕾拿着签过的表出来。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn xiěmíng , kěyǐ chéngdān hézhǔn jiājù de zhǔnbèi , cè dú hé zhǐdìng zhuāngpèi xiézuò , xū yǒu fùzérén zàichǎng , bùnéng jùcǐ cāozuò jiù shèshī , yě bùnéng zìxíng gēnghuàn cáiliào .
pairs.english: It specified preparation, readings and assigned assembly assistance for approved fixtures, with a responsible supervisor present; it authorized neither operating old installations nor changing materials independently.
pairs.hanzi: 上面写明，可以承担核准夹具的准备、测读和指定装配协作，须有负责人在场，不能据此操作旧设施，也不能自行更换材料。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zuìhòu yìháng dú le liǎngbiàn , cái wèn zhè shìbushì guò le . " zhèxiàng guò le . " tā shuō , " búshì shānshàng suǒyǒu de mén dōu guī nǐ kāi . "
pairs.english: Tavi read the last line twice before asking if he had passed. “This part, yes,” she said. “It does not mean every door in the mountains is yours to open.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维将最后一行读了两遍，才问这是不是过了。
“这项过了。”她说，“不是山上所有的门都归你开。”

pairs.target: yīwén shēntóu láikàn . tǎ wéi méi duǒ , jiāng biǎo dìguòqù , hūrán xiǎngqǐ mǐlā jīntiān qù le gōngfáng , dé mǎ zài guò jǐtiān yě yào zǒu .
pairs.english: Iven leaned in to look. Tavi did not hide it, handing over the sheet, and suddenly remembered Mira had gone to the works today and Dema would leave in a few days too.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文伸头来看。塔维没躲，将表递过去，忽然想起米拉今天去了工房，德玛再过几天也要走。

pairs.target: yuánlái tāmen bìng búshì lúnliú zhàn zài tóng yìzhāng zhuōqián , děng shuí xiān bǎ suǒyǒu shìqíng zuò wán .
pairs.english: They were not simply taking turns at the same table, waiting to see who finished everything first.
pairs.hanzi: 原来他们并不是轮流站在同一张桌前，等谁先把所有事情做完。

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn tā chī guò zǎofàn méiyǒu . tā shuō chī le bànkuài bǐng , tā kànzhe tā de yījīn , shuō kàndéchūlái .
pairs.english: Nerai asked if he had eaten breakfast. He said half a flatbread; looking at his tunic, she said she could tell.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问他吃过早饭没有。他说吃了半块饼，她看着他的衣襟，说看得出来。

pairs.target: tā dītóu qù pāi bǐng zhā , yīwén bǎ biǎo jǔ gāo , miǎnde tā yì zhǎng pāishàngqù . nài lěi yǐjīng zhuǎnshēn qù fàntīng , jiào tāmen gēn lái , shuō jīntiān zhìshǎo yǒurén gāi chī yídùn bù xūyào jiǎnhuílái de zǎofàn .
pairs.english: He looked down to brush off the crumbs; Iven lifted the sheet to spare it a slap. Nerai had already turned toward the dining hall and called them along, saying someone deserved a breakfast today that did not need picking up afterward.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头去拍饼渣，伊文把表举高，免得他一掌拍上去。奈蕾已经转身去饭厅，叫他们跟来，说今天至少有人该吃一顿不需要捡回来的早饭。
